priorityList: Recklessness on cooldown or whenever burst damage is needed
Rampage if Enrage is not active or more than 100 Rage
Thunder Clap to fill the rotation
Cast Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally together.
Cast Thunder Blast if you are Enraged.
Cast Rampage if you are not Enraged or if you are about to cap Rage (110+ Rage).
Cast Bloodthirst (or Bloodbath) to generate Rage and maintain Enrage.
Cast Thunder Clap to generate Rage and trigger Mountain Thane passives.
Cast Raging Blow only if no other high-priority abilities are available.
Cast Slam as a final filler if nothing else is available.
